note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a POR 6(1); A06b POR 6(1); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Organic Law 1/2026 (Diário da República, 18 May 2026) rewrote article 6(1): naturalisation now asks ten years' legal residence, or seven for nationals of Portuguese-speaking countries and citizens of EU Member States (the shorter period by nationality isn't modelled, so ten is); nothing on renunciation or loss changed.
